hub.description: Learn how to record meetings in HeyMoa, name speakers, add meeting context and a glossary, review summaries, and connect the desktop app and AI apps.
hub.lead: Search for a word, or browse by feature or by situation.
hub.uiNote: The HeyMoa app is in Korean for now. This guide refers to its buttons and screens by their English names.

start.title: Getting started
start.summary: Sign in to HeyMoa, record your first meeting, and get to know the screens, your account, and the desktop app.

record.title: Recording and transcription
record.summary: Record and transcribe meetings, set attendees and speakers as you go, and use the glossary and the timeline.

summary.title: Summary and review
summary.summary: After a meeting ends, review and confirm the decisions and tasks AI pulled out, then copy them or share them as a PDF or by email.

team.title: Working together
team.summary: Share tasks with your team, ask My agent about your meetings, invite members, and send us questions.

connect.title: Connections
connect.summary: Connect tools like Linear and GitHub, and let outside AI apps read your meetings over MCP.

fix.title: When something goes wrong
fix.summary: Fixes for the messages you may see when using HeyMoa.

situations.title: Browse by situation
situations.summary: Pick a situation you've run into in HeyMoa, like your first meeting, a recording problem, or reviewing a summary, and see where to look and what to do.

media.zoomClose: Press Esc to close the enlarged view.

search.label: Search the whole guide
search.dialogHelp: Type to search the whole guide. Use the up and down arrow keys to pick a result, then press Enter to go there.
